title: Astrid and the Provision
author: August Amberdale
blurb: Mirabel Sandoval, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
